name: vitesse-nuxt-monorepo
description: Hardened Nuxt and Express monorepo template based on antfu's Vitesse Nuxt
author: Jacob Anderson

scripts.build: npm run -w front-end build && npm run -w back-end build
scripts.build:netlify: npm run -w front-end build && npm run -w back-end typecheck
scripts.lint-server: npm run -w back-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end server
scripts.lint-serve: npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w front-end serve
scripts.lint: npm run lint:root && npm run -w front-end lint && npm run -w back-end lint
scripts.lint-fix: eslint "*.{js,ts,mjs,cjs}" scripts netlify --fix && npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end lint-fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w front-end typecheck && npm run -w back-end typecheck && tsc -p netlify/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run -w back-end test && node --test scripts/test-archiver-compat.mjs scripts/test-glob-compat.mjs scripts/test-listhen-compat.mjs scripts/test-braces-compat.mjs scripts/test-deepmerge-compat.mjs scripts/test-qs-compat.mjs scripts/test-vendored-qs-packaging.mjs scripts/test-vue-devtools-compat.mjs scripts/test-toolchain-compat.mjs scripts/test-frontend-command.mjs && npm run test:devtools && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_runtime_artifact.py -v
scripts.audit:qs: npm audit --prefix vendor/qs --workspaces=false --audit-level=low && npm audit --prefix vendor/qs --workspaces=false --omit=dev --audit-level=low
scripts.audit:api: npm audit --prefix back-end --audit-level=low && npm audit --prefix back-end --omit=dev --audit-level=low
scripts.validate: npm run check:qs-package && npm run check:vue-devtools-package && npm run check:dependency-graph && npm run check:native-bindings && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:deploy-output && npm run check:api-install
